scope: Minimal source excerpts reconstructed from diff context and changed lines. sourceStartLines restores original line numbers in the fake pinned reader; missing full-file regions are not modeled. Base SHA is the captured PR merge_base. Secret expressions are redacted.
labels: absent and intended-fix bodies are historical PR 66 claims. Misattributed, stale-409, valid and failure-severity cases and valid/false disputes are synthetic pipeline controls, not claims about actual repository defects. Double-check verdicts are canned; this does not evaluate a live model.
